verses.1: A song of ascents. Behold, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand in the house of the LORD in the night.
verses.2: Lift up your hands to the holy place and bless the LORD.
verses.3: May the LORD bless you from Zion, the one who made the heavens and the earth.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: The phrase "הִנֵּה" ("Behold") is retained for its emphatic function. The term "בֵּית־יְהוָה" is rendered "the house of the LORD" to reflect its liturgical setting.
- v. 3: "מִצִּיּוֹן" is translated as "from Zion" to maintain its geographic and symbolic reference.
raw:
[1] A song of ascents. Behold, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand in the house of the LORD in the night.

[2] Lift up your hands to the holy place and bless the LORD.

[3] May the LORD bless you from Zion, the one who made the heavens and the earth.

- v. 3: "מִצִּיּוֹן" is translated as "from Zion" to maintain its geographic and symbolic reference.
